1. (Currently amended) A system for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: a processor; and a memory, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords extracted from metadata or content of the items; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords selected based on highest frequency of occurrence, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud has an associated size that is proportional to the keyword's frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with a selected keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; and generating the lower-level lexical cloud as a second subset of keywords from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the second subset is sized proportionally to its frequency in the temporary data structure.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display the top-level lexical cloud and obtain a user selection of a keyword in the top-level lexical cloud.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display a filtered subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, on keywords selected sequentially from the top-level lexical cloud and one or more lower-level lexical clouds.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, comprising a storage device that comprises technical documents, patents, Web pages, word processing documents, spreadsheet documents, or any combinations thereof, wherein the items are stored in the storage device.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 4, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to access files stored in the storage device and to generate the plurality of keywords by extracting words from the files and filtering the extracted words.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords displayed in the top-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and a maximum number of keywords that can be displayed without overlap.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords displayed in the lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and a maximum number of keywords that can be displayed without overlap.

8. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a size of each keyword in a lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on the frequency of the keyword in the temporary data structure.

9. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to select a subset of the plurality of keywords based, at least in part, on a frequency of occurrence of each keyword in the data structure.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate the top-level lexical cloud and lower-level lexical clouds dynamically in response to user interactions.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate and display a list of items to display based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and selections from the lexical clouds.

12. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on user input or metadata associated with the items.

13. (Currently amended) A method for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: generating a data structure in a non-transitory, computer readable medium, comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords extracted from metadata or content of the items; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generating a top-level lexical cloud by selecting a subset of the plurality of keywords based on highest frequency of occurrence, wherein each keyword in the subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the data structure; and generating a lower-level lexical cloud by: creating a temporary data structure by eliminating any items not associated with a selected keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; and generating a second subset of keywords from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the second subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the temporary data structure.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the second subset is selected by ranking keywords by overall frequency of occurrence in the temporary data structure after elimination of items not associated with the selected keyword.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising obtaining the plurality of keywords by: obtaining a list of words associated with an item from the item's content or metadata; excluding common words from the list using a stopword filter; stemming or lemmatizing words to obtain the plurality of keywords; and storing each of the plurality of keywords in the data structure.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising displaying a filtered list of items selected from the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a sequential selection of a first keyword from the top-level lexical cloud and a second keyword from the lower-level lexical cloud.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising generating at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on user-provided descriptions or metadata associated with the items.

18. (Currently amended) A non-transitory, computer-readable medium, comprising code configured to direct a processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords extracted from metadata or content of the items; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud by selecting a subset of the plurality of keywords based on highest frequency of occurrence, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with a selected keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; and generating a second subset of keywords from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the second subset is sized proportionally to its frequency in the temporary data structure.

19. (Currently amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display the top-level lexical cloud and obtain a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud.

20. (Currently amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display a filtered subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a first keyword selected from the top-level lexical cloud and a second keyword selected from the lower-level lexical cloud.
